observation: signal plus independent Normal(0,sigma_kw^2) noise; new RNG(seed), draw constant then rectangle then ramp
method: exact penalized piecewise-constant dynamic programming; not PELT
objective: sum within-segment squared residuals + penalty * number_of_internal_changepoints
complexity: O(n^2) time and O(n) auxiliary storage via prefix sufficient statistics

independent_check.method: enumerate all 2^(n-1) cut subsets, reject segments shorter than 3; compute two-pass mean/residual SSE independently of DP prefix formula

scope: Development correctness and misspecification description only. No F0 superiority claim, no tuning, no main training/validation/test access.
conclusion_rule: Report observed step boundaries and nearest true-boundary errors, constant false splits and ramp segment counts. A slow continuous ramp has no finite piecewise-constant true changepoints; multiple fitted segments describe approximation rather than recovered physical stages.
